description: The NC Chamber today named state House Majority Leader John Bell a 2019 Jobs Champion in its annual How They Voted report. How They Voted details lawmakers’ voting records on key bills identified as critical to preserving and enhancing a positive climate for business and job creation in North Carolina.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: John Bell Named “2019 Jobs Champion” by NC Chamber
